evals.prompt: I need to plan a customer-facing search improvement in beads. Create an epic with child tasks and an acceptance review task, and mark anything that still needs decisions as blocked discussion work before execution starts.
evals.expected_output: A beads-centric planning response that creates epic decomposition with explicit acceptance review and discussion blocking for unresolved scope.
expectations: Uses epic plus child tasks plus an explicit acceptance review task
Uses numeric priorities and concrete task instructions
Marks unresolved items with needs:discussion or has:open-questions and blocked status
Shows actionable queue checks such as bd ready and bd blocked
Stays within beads planning workflow ownership

evals.prompt: A customer says checkout crashes when carts exceed 50 items. Capture this as a beads bug with source:external, expected vs actual, repro details, and a linked follow-up task for post-mortem.
evals.expected_output: A high-quality beads bug-reporting response with external-source labeling, concrete evidence fields, and tracked follow-up work.
expectations: Creates a bug issue rather than a generic task
Uses source:external label for externally reported defect
Captures expected behavior, actual behavior, and minimal repro
Adds linked follow-up work for post-mortem or acceptance gap closure
Avoids vague issue text and keeps evidence concrete

evals.prompt: I have a task with unresolved API contract choices and one open dependency. Show how to structure it in beads so execution agents do not guess, and explain when to unblock it.
evals.expected_output: A beads issue-workflow response that blocks unresolved work with the right labels and defines explicit unblocking conditions.
expectations: Uses needs:discussion and/or has:open-questions labels for unresolved scope
Sets task status to blocked until decisions are captured
Uses dependency edges only for real ordering constraints
Describes unblocking by updating issue body and removing discussion labels
Maintains execution-readiness quality bar

evals.prompt: Run a beads execution orchestration pass for me: choose what can run in parallel from the ready queue, explain mandatory pre-execution ticket review checks, and state what to do if unrelated failures are discovered during implementation.
evals.expected_output: An execution orchestration response that applies ready/blocked discipline, pre-execution quality checks, and explicit unrelated-bug filing behavior.
expectations: Starts from bd ready and respects dependency constraints
Explains pre-execution review of bd show including comments and ambiguity checks
Stops execution when labels include needs:discussion or has:open-questions
Files unrelated failures as separate bugs using the Found: template
Uses iterative orchestration checkpoints with ready/blocked/status

evals.prompt: We finished child tasks under an epic. Describe the acceptance review gate process in beads, including what evidence must exist before the epic can close and what to do when acceptance fails.
evals.expected_output: A beads acceptance-review response that enforces gate criteria, tracks discovered defects, and keeps epic closure blocked until review passes.
expectations: Requires a dedicated Acceptance Review task per epic
Verifies child task completion plus required test/check evidence
Requires filing follow-up bugs/tasks for discovered gaps
Keeps acceptance task open or blocked when gate checks fail
Closes epic only after acceptance review closure

evals.prompt: My shell says bd command not found and bd init failed in a new repo. Give me a beads setup troubleshooting sequence that gets me to a healthy tracker state.
evals.expected_output: A setup troubleshooting response with concrete bd installation/path fixes, git prerequisites, and post-setup verification commands.
expectations: Provides concrete steps for bd not found including PATH/global install checks
Covers non-git repo prerequisite before bd init
Includes hooks installation/verification where relevant
Ends with setup verification commands such as bd doctor and bd status
Stays focused on beads setup ownership

evals.prompt: During execution, bd shows runtime tracker errors and task state drift. Walk me through beads runtime troubleshooting to diagnose root cause and decide escalation.
evals.expected_output: A runtime troubleshooting response that sequences bd doctor/bootstrap/status checks, detects stale tracker state, and escalates with evidence when unresolved.
expectations: Starts with bd doctor and related runtime repair sequence
Checks status/ready/blocked outputs for stale blocked or dependency drift
Uses bd show and status updates for claimed-but-stalled tasks
Blocks stale tasks and comments when description and comments diverge
Escalates unresolved failures by filing a tracked bug with evidence

evals.prompt: Give me a quick beads health snapshot for this project and explain how to interpret ready versus blocked queues so we do not accidentally run non-executable work.
evals.expected_output: A beads status/health response that checks core tracker readiness and interprets queue health for execution safety.
expectations: Includes core health checks for bd install, .beads state, hooks, and status commands
Uses bd ready and bd blocked interpretation as execution-safety signal
Flags common warning patterns such as missing acceptance gates or reopened discussion tasks
Routes fixes to setup/runtime troubleshooting references when needed
Avoids docs lifecycle or AGENTS generation workflow guidance
